default_for: retired 2026-10-21; decision 5 now defaults to Hailuo 02 Standard 768P

request_shape.duration_s: clamp(ceil(shot_seconds + 1.0), 4, 15): one second of trim handle; catalog window 4-15 s, default 6
request_shape.first_frame_url: the approved keyframe for this shot (image-to-video). H3 takes ONE image: first_frame_url OR last_frame_url (67 catalog max_reference_images 1).
request_shape.audio: post_processing only: minimax-h3 returns a stereo track on every take and exposes no flag to disable it. The Suno master is the soundtrack (video_router 16.2 default); the generated track is stripped in post. See native_audio.

native_audio.provider: minimax-h3/text-to-video and image-to-video return a stereo audio track on every take

decisions.retain: keep the generated track as the mix bed; no separate soundtrack may be layered over it
decisions.reduce_music: keep dialogue and ambience, duck the generated music before the soundtrack is laid in
decisions.strip: remove the generated track and lay the approved soundtrack over the silent take

native_audio.prompt_note: The SOUND_AND_TEXT fragment asks the model for no speech, music or sound effects. That is an instruction to the model and a post-processing intent; it is never a provider-side disable, so a take must still be measured and stripped before mixing.
native_audio.receipt: prompt_templates.receipt() echoes native_audio (decision, provider_can_disable, enforcement, prompt_ambition, observed) on every H3 prompt receipt; the request carries the same block.

sections.source: spec: shot_id, shot_type, duration_s, aspect, beat, one-line intent
spec.subject + spec.composition: who, where in frame, pose, setting, foreground/midground/background layers
spec.action: ONE main action, explicit START state (= first frame), explicit END state, direction in screen terms
spec.camera: one bracket group (1 main move, at most 3 combined) + the same move in plain words
spec.lens_light: focal length, framing, focus target, key/fill/rim direction and motivation, photographic treatment
character DNA records (character_continuity) + wardrobe for this scene + first-frame match
mode block (modes/*.json h3_block) + look palette override
BOOK_CLOSED always when spec.book is set; BOOK_OPEN_MOTION added when spec.book == 'open' (U10 contract wording)
spec.motion_physics: weight, contact, cloth, hair, breath, blink cadence, object behaviour
spec.beats: 3-5 time-stamped beats that add up to duration_s
BASE_NEGATIVES + shot_type negatives + spec.negatives_extra; at most 16 items, highest priority first

fragments.REFERENCE_FRAME: Screen-left and screen-right are always from the camera's point of view: screen-left is the left edge of the frame and screen-right is the right edge. Words like her right hand or her left shoulder name the character's own body side. Toward the camera means toward the lens; away means deeper into the set.
fragments.SOUND_AND_TEXT: The clip is silent: no dialogue, music or sound effects, because the song is added in the edit. No captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks or readable signs are generated; any surface that would carry writing shows soft, unreadable texture, because exact words are added in post-production.
fragments.PRINTED_PAGES: Every visible page is filled with dense, realistic printed text: small black serif type in even lines and paragraph blocks, consistent margins and page numbers. There are no blank pages and no large empty white areas. The text stays upright and not mirrored, and it is unreadable at this distance.
BASE_NEGATIVES: no scene cut, jump cut or fade inside the clip
no morphing of one face into another
no extra people beyond those named
no extra, missing or fused fingers
no sudden exposure or colour shift
no mirrored or reversed objects or lettering
fragments.BOOK_CLOSED: The hardcover book shows its front cover to the camera, upright. The spine is on the left edge of the book as seen in frame and the fore-edge is on the right. The cover matches the first frame exactly: same art, same title and author lettering, reading left to right, never mirrored, and the back cover is never shown. The book never rotates more than fifteen degrees.
fragments.BOOK_OPEN_MOTION: To open, the right edge of the front cover lifts first and the cover swings leftward around the spine, so the book opens from right to left as the viewer sees it and comes to rest open with both pages facing the camera. Page turns: one page at a time lifts from the right-hand stack, arcs leftward and settles on the left-hand stack, slowly and evenly.

camera_vocabulary.status: Bracket syntax is documented for Hailuo 02/2.3 image-to-video (platform.minimax.io, file 17). For H3 it is UNVERIFIED, so every bracket is followed by the same move in plain words.
rules: exactly one bracket group per prompt
one main move; at most 3 moves combined inside the bracket, comma separated
[Shake] is never used (it fights the identity lock and the 'no camera shake' negative)
book, product-close and text-surface shots use [Static shot] or a slow [Push in] only
the camera move is described separately from the subject's motion, with its own direction and speed

expand_priority: beats: split the longest beat into two, each with what visibly changes
subject: name the background layer and two set-dressing objects that belong to this location (from the location record)
physics: name the materials that move in this shot (cloth, hair, paper, liquid, steam) and how
lens_light: state the key light's source, side and colour temperature, and where the shadow falls
action: describe the body's path between start and end (weight shift, hands, gaze)
continuity: add the prop states that must persist (what is in the hands, what is on the table)
expand_rule: Expansion only adds NEW facts about this shot from the shot spec, the location record, the character record or the beat. It never repeats a sentence, never restates a block, never adds bare adjective lists. If the spec has no more facts and the prompt is still under the floor, the assembler refuses with H3_THIN_SPEC naming the empty slots, and the planner must supply them.
